verdict.rationale: Anytype's own infrastructure handles background syncing and backups automatically across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android, and the docs say content is encrypted and 'not even Anytype can see your content' (docs-42, docs-71, docs-54, docs-31, docs-44). Community users independently confirm cross-device sync works well (comm-4, comm-16, comm-2). One user notes data is unencrypted on local disk, but that concerns local at-rest storage, not vendor-side readability. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the end-to-end encryption scheme for synced data, independent verification that the sync server cannot read content.
